A. Priya
B. Harriet
C. Marcus
D. Dev

[1] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:39:00) same, I'll probably head direct. I've got a supervision call until 6 anyway so I'd barely make the food
[2] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:37:00) thai works for me lol. dev you coming for the food or just the stars
[4] (about=Tomás, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:37:00) Thai at Cecilia's then Blackmoor, that's the plan sorted mate 🌌✨
[5] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:22:00) Ruth and I met at the county natural-history society in 2021 and discovered within about twenty minutes that we both preferred the stars to anything else on the programme. We agreed to meet the following Friday with our own telescopes in my back garden. There were two of us, a 4-inch refractor, Ruth's old 80mm, and a thermos of tea. I remember we stayed out until 2am on a school night and neither of us could see the point of going in. It grew from there one person at a time. In my experience the quiet beginning is the only honest beginning a group like this can have.
[7] (about=Harriet, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:20:00) I want to pick up the thread Harriet left last month about how this group started. Nadia, can I ask you properly: what was it like the first time you got people together in your back garden? You and Ruth, was it just the two of you at first?
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:29:00) Harriet, what was the Bortle class?
[9] (about=Harriet, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:49:00) Unanimous then, or nearly. I will note for the record that I pushed for darker sites before the weekend and I am gratified. But I want to add something: this group started in Nadia's back garden, did it not? Nadia, Ruth, you two dragged everyone here. I think people forget that the whole thing was your idea originally.
[10] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:29:00) I came to a public star party three years ago expecting to be bored and left having already signed up for the next session. I think most people here have a version of that story. One look at something real through an eyepiece and that's it, you're done. I am organising the annual dark-sky weekend again for next October and I would love for Harriet to record the whole event for the podcast!!! 🌟🌟🌟
